description: This file defines custom exception classes related to the ONNX exporter in PyTorch, including warnings, errors, and specific exceptions for unsupported operators and symbolic value issues.

classes.name: OnnxExporterError
classes.description: Base class for all exporter errors.

classes.name: UnsupportedOperatorError
classes.description: Error raised when an operator is unsupported by the exporter. It includes logic to generate error messages based on operator name and version support.

classes.name: SymbolicValueError
classes.description: Error related to TorchScript values and nodes, includes detailed message construction with information about the value, its type, source location, and inputs/outputs.
